about: The Fable diagnosis run: the preregistered primary analysis (feature-split.ts on the committed merged trial list and labels.json), which holds every headline, group and interaction number in the report.

not_rebuilt.what: The merged trial list and per-shard results (results/merged/, results/shards/, results/stopped/, results/verifier-unavailable.json)
not_rebuilt.reason: They were written by the run itself; verify uses them as this run's receipts.

not_rebuilt.what: The task labels (labels.json) and the oracle checks (oracle-check.json, oracle-check-first-run.json)
not_rebuilt.reason: They are pinned by the preregistration and were built before the run from the task source, which the repository does not hold.

not_rebuilt.what: The count of fetches of the fixed code (results/contamination/)
not_rebuilt.reason: release-fetch-audit.ts reads the trials' Harbor transcripts, which are not in the repository.

not_rebuilt.what: The without-fetches and no-safety-stop sensitivity lines, the per-language lines and the time and context lines in report.md
not_rebuilt.reason: They were computed from filtered trial lists and the shards' proxy usage logs, which are not in the repository.

not_rebuilt.what: The trace reads (trace-read.md, post-run-trace-read.md and their folders)
not_rebuilt.reason: They were written by blind readers from the harness transcripts, which are not in the repository.
